detail: The story repro opens the login URL and signs in as alice. The cases start from an already signed-in context. Add or adapt one case that signs in from anonymous with the malicious returnUrl and asserts the final landing page is on the WebApp (/).
The fix rule implies that `///evil.example` and a leading `\\evil.example` fall back to `/`. Neither is covered.
The step says 'Search testing/flows/' without naming the file (identity-basket.md) or the row text to match.

The case requires running auth-login.spec.ts and asserting the protocol-relative test executes (not skipped) and passes, every other test passes, and the exit code is 0. The test only reads the file text and checks that the test title is present and test.fixme is absent, so it would pass with test.skip or a commented-out test and does not check the run result.
The nested run uses --retries=1 and accepts status 'flaky' for the protocol-relative test, so a test that fails first and passes on retry still satisfies the case's 'passes' requirement.
